title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
title_zh: SOAR：面向搜索智能体的源感知强化学习与精确信用分配
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%. These confirm that SOAR significantly improves performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks while effectively mitigating evidence fabrication, fostering more faithful and grounded reasoning with enhanced robustness.
abstract_zh: 搜索智能体中的强化学习常出现“证据伪造”：智能体绕过外部信息（E_ext），转而依赖不可靠的内部知识（E_int）生成错误答案。论文认为，推理轨迹的不透明性促使智能体将内部知识作为捷径。为此，提出 SOAR（SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning），将单体式推理转换为显式标注信息来源的推理轨迹。SOAR 包含两个核心设计：通过 Source-Aware Workflow 将外部知识与内部知识解耦为并行且可观测的信息流；通过 Source-Consistent Reward 引导策略学习，使不同知识流能够获得精确的信用分配。在 3B 和 7B 参数规模的骨干模型上，SOAR 相比基线分别提升 7.3% 和 5.4%，并将证据伪造降低 74.8%。结果表明，SOAR 能提升知识密集型基准上的性能，有效缓解证据伪造，促进更忠实、更具依据且更稳健的推理。
key_points_zh: 核心问题是搜索智能体过度依赖不可靠的内部知识，绕过外部证据并生成伪造依据。
Source-Aware Workflow 将外部知识（E_ext）与内部知识（E_int）拆分为并行、可观测的信息流。
Source-Consistent Reward 根据知识来源进行奖励设计，实现不同信息流之间更精确的信用分配。
在 3B 和 7B 骨干模型上分别提升 7.3% 和 5.4%，同时将证据伪造减少 74.8%。
SOAR 提升知识密集型任务性能，并增强推理的忠实性、可溯源性与鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: SOAR is strong search-agent RL work that makes evidence sources observable and enables more precise trajectory-level credit assignment.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SOAR是较强的搜索智能体强化学习工作，通过显式化证据来源实现了更精确的轨迹级信用分配。
